what.text: This page follows refugees from Türkiye living in the United Kingdom, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5906 Turkish refugees in the United Kingdom, 4.0% of all refugees from Türkiye.
Germany hosts the most Turkish refugees, followed by France, Canada and Switzerland.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Kurdistan territory in Turkey with the PKK from 1984 to 2013 and from 2015 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2015 to 2017 and over the government in some years.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1988 at 126 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 9260, at the end of 2007.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1993 to 2011 and 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United Kingdom.
These are year-end totals for the United Kingdom only, reported to UNHCR.
